learning_outcomes.text: To give students knowledge about the application of computers in the design process.
Consideration of methods of geometrical modeling of parts or assemblies.
Consideration of general questions connected with the creation of CAD systems.

syllabus_topics: General information about the design of technical objects
2D-drawings from the 3D-solid models of parts and assemblies
teaching_methods: practical classes in a computer room

assessment_methods.method: oral test control on basic topics

assessment_rules: Assessment is continuous. There is an oral test control on basic topics at the beginning of the classes. Each student has an assignment to solve individual tasks, which is graded. The exam type is written.
institution: University Of Ruse Angel Kanchev — Industrial Engineering (Bachelor)
academic_year: Paquete ECTS de la FMME (datos 2008/09-posteriores; ver notas)
